notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]Today, we have some sad news to share.[/p][p]It’s never easy to say goodbye…[/p][p][/p][h3]We’re officially retiring Youniverse.[/h3][p]Thank you for being part of Youniverse—your support has truly meant the world to us. notes.title: Festive Fun Arrives in Youniverse!
notes.notes:
Get ready to step into a winter wonderland in Youniverse with our latest festive updates: 

1. Decorate the Tree: Add your personal touch to the grand Christmas tree!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229968/e731b8f01a7d66b872ca72c035fcb58c6784d6ce.png[/img]

2. Snowball Fights: Aim, throw and watch for their reactions!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229968/f55864934809773ccda441c1db42a4b2d5157aa9.gif[/img]

3. Christmas Light Show: Gather with friends and enjoy a dazzling light display.
4. Magical Train Ride: Hop aboard the enchanted train for a scenic festive journey.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229968/77726ddee22707304c34fa2f978c0aeaae638a2b.gif[/img]

Log in now and let the holiday magic begin!

notes.title: Holiday Fun Update!
notes.notes:
Hey players!

We’ve been working hard to bring some festive cheer to the game, just in time for Christmas! This update is packed with fun activities and decorations to help you celebrate the holiday season in style. Check out what’s new:

[list]
[*] Snowball Fight: Jump into a snowy battle and throw snowballs for some winter fun!
[*] Christmas Tree Lights: Choose from 3 different light styles to make your tree shine!
[*] Mural Painting: Show your creativity by designing cool wall art!
[*] Christmas City Makeover: Explore a city full of holiday spirit and decorations!
[/list]

We’d love to hear what you think!
Don’t forget to share your feedback with us—it helps us make the game even better. Happy holidays and have fun playing!

notes.title: Introducing the Chat Feature in Youniverse!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229968/a57eb2dc555e4fe863b4ba0f89448258264ea9c6.png[/img]

Here’s how it works:
Step 1: Approach your friend and press E to start a chat request.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229968/7bbcf1044396fa4772ce292f962fdf3a6b511040.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229968/0c6aad70859e2b6bbd7f01e4aa8a7fcfe2e9cd28.png[/img]

Step 2: Your friend will receive the request and needs to accept it.
Step 3: Once accepted, you’re all set to chat and connect in Youniverse! 🎉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45229968/0d82df07cf718da62625baf253b690637f41e855.png[/img]

Start chatting and make your virtual world even more social!

notes.title: New Additions & Feature Updates to Youniverse!
notes.notes:
Here's our updates for this latest release. Do take time to review it and let us know your thoughts!
Added:
[list]
[*] Custom quiz creation where you can add on your own questions
[*] Ability to directly log in using your STEAM account
[*] New hairdos for avatar
[*] New hair physics for that natural look!
[*] Added interaction for TV and lights in apartment
[/list]
Fixed & Adjusted:
[list]
[*] NPC now no longer refers to "Hey man!" in speech.
[*] Improved visuals for apartment with better FOV and lighting
[*] General bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: We Hear You, and We’re Committed to Doing Better
notes.notes:
[b]To Our Youniverse Community,[/b]

Over the past week, we’ve seen the reviews and heard the concerns from many of you. First and foremost, THANK YOU for taking the time to share your honest feedback, even when it’s REALLY hard for us to read😢. Your passion and love for gaming—and for what Youniverse could be—means the world to us.

We acknowledge that we haven’t met your expectations. As a platform aiming to build a vibrant, interactive social world, a world where you can escape the realities of life, many aspects of the experience have fallen short. Whether it’s bugs, features that don’t quite feel right, or areas where our vision hasn’t yet fully materialized, we hear you loud and clear.

Building Youniverse is not merely about creating a platform; it’s about creating a home—a place where you can play, connect, and create memories. And with what it is at the moment, it’s nowhere at that level! We recognize that we need to do a whole lot better to live up to that promise.

This is not just our project; [i]it’s our community’s project[/i]. Your feedback is the compass guiding us forward. 

We promise to:
[list]
[*] [b]Address the issues:[/b] From gameplay bugs to UI concerns, we’re already prioritizing fixes and improvements.We are looking to release new updates fortnightly. 

[*] [b]Listen more[/b]: We’re opening up more channels for feedback so every voice can be heard. Youniverse is a platform that is constantly evolving and being developed. It’s not a ONCE and DONE kind of game. [i] https://linktr.ee/youniversegames[/i]

[*][b] Collaborate[/b]: We’re committed to involving you, our players, in shaping the future of Youniverse. If you’re a 3D artist, a designer or a passionate gamer, we want to work with you! 
[/list]

We know words alone can’t fix things. What we can offer is our absolute dedication to making Youniverse a place we can all be proud of. We believe in this platform, and we know it has the potential to be so much more. So come onboard with us and let’s make it happen together! 

To those of you who have given us your words of encouragement, thank you for your patience and trust. To those we’ve let down, we are deeply sorry. You deserve better, and we will do better.
Let’s keep the conversation going. Your feedback is what will make Youniverse grow into something truly special. Together, we can build a platform that reflects all of our dreams and ambitions.

With gratitude and determination,
[b]The Youniverse Team[/b]
